Fact delta between two commits

Usage: ryi diff [OPTIONS] --from <REV> --to <REV>

Options:
      --root <DIR>      Repository root (default: git root of the working directory)
      --from <REV>      Base revision
      --to <REV>        Target revision
      --pattern <GLOB>  Glob to include; repeatable (default: every roster extension)
      --arms <ARMS>     Resolve arms (call,type)
      --sqlite <PATH>   Write to a new SQLite database instead of stdout
  -h, --help            Print help
